name: Águas do Algarve: Disponibilidades Hídricas (reservoir storage table)
owner: Águas do Algarve, S.A. (Grupo Águas de Portugal)
gives: reservoir storage (volume in hm3 and percent, total and useful) for Odelouca, Odeleite and Beliche
reservoir capacity and full-storage level for those three dams

why.basis: page footer copyright notice (all rights reserved; no reuse licence or open-data terms found on the site, the only legal links being cookies and data protection); robots.txt (https://www.aguasdoalgarve.pt/robots.txt, 200) has User-agent * with Crawl-delay: 10 and does not disallow /content/

interface: Server-rendered HTML page, no key, no login. Six HTML tables (one header block plus one dated table per dam). Per dam: Nível Máximo de Cheia (m), Nível de Pleno Armazenamento (m), Capacidade Total (hm3), Capacidade Útil (hm3); then rows of Data, Volume Total (hm3, %), Volume Útil (hm3, %). No JSON, CSV or API seen. Dates are written dd/mm/yy.
notes: Read 18 Nov 2026. Rows shown: 16/10/25 (same week a year earlier) then weekly Fridays 18/09/26, 25/09/26, 02/10/26, 09/10/26, 16/10/26. Latest row 16/10/26 is therefore about a month behind today, so the page is updated late or in batches; check the lag before promising 'current'. Latest values (Águas do Algarve, 16/10/26): Odelouca 112.86 hm3, 71.82% total, 65.46% useful; Odeleite 91.65 hm3, 70.50% total, 64.75% useful; Beliche 29.96 hm3, 62.41% total, 57.94% useful. Capacities: Odelouca 157.14 hm3 total (128.2 useful), Odeleite 130.00 (108.80), Beliche 48.00 (42.89). Covers only the three dams that supply Águas do Algarve; Bravura, Arade and Funcho are NOT on this page. Because the site claims all rights reserved, taking figures on a schedule needs Dinis to decide, or a written OK from Águas do Algarve (geral.ada@adp.pt is the contact shown in the page header); facts such as a single percentage are not the same as copying the table, but that is a judgement for Dinis. Also read: robots Crawl-delay 10 means no more than one request per 10 seconds.
